description: The published release register of one APPROVED compliance policy: every extracted provision with its legal reference, review verdict and disposition, the treatment rendered in the Rego (or why it was excluded), its status (enforced, attested, unsupported or informational), the fields it needs, and the approved hash, version and effective date. Use it to see what an evaluation actually covers and which provisions are NOT encoded — a pass on the encoded checks is not compliance with the excluded provisions. Paid plans only; requires the compliance:read scope.
name: compliance_policy_register
